text: {"name":"rf_prepare_setup","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Selects an RF setup path, writes the shifted input and mode-specific setup values, and returns the fixed status 236.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v1":"setup_record","v2":"profile_byte_index","v3":"setup_value","v4":"mode_mask","v5":"shifted_input","v6":"config_base","v8":"control_register_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Setup word derived from the input by shifting it left 15 bits."},{"offset":6,"meaning":"Configuration mode byte; a value of 1 enables the corresponding mode bit."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Setup-record field set to 3; the configuration base is also written with a mode-specific value here."},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Setup-record field set to 1."}]}
